# Track 9 Auto & Tire Shop

> Bilingual (English and Spanish) automotive tire and mechanical repair shop with 18 years of industry experience and 5 years of independent shop ownership, offering new and used tires, flat tire repair, brake replacement, oil changes, alignment, and suspension services.

Track 9 Auto & Tire serves drivers in both English and Spanish. Customers can call or text (214) 524-8939 or submit a quote request on the website for tire sales, tire repair, brake replacement, oil and filter changes, shock absorber installation, caliper and disc replacement, and wheel alignment and balancing.

## Pages
- [English Home](https://track9autotire.com/): Primary English landing page detailing all services, used tire brands, specials, owner story, photo gallery, social channels, and free quote form.
- [Inicio en Español](https://track9autotire.com/es): Complete Spanish landing page detailing services, used tire brands, specials, owner story, photo gallery, social channels, and free quote form.

## Services
- Sale of New and Used Tires (Atlas Tires, Atlander Tire, Cargo Max, Delinte, Premiorri, Rosava, Fullrun, Fullway, Haida, Land Golden, Landspider, Suretrac, Travelstar, Leao Tyre, Gripmax)
- Tire Repair and Maintenance (including flat tire repair specials)
- Brake Replacement, Caliper and Disc Replacement
- Oil and Filter Change
- Shock Absorber Installation
- Alignment and Balancing
